method: Independently extracted and viewed actual burned MP4; 52 cover/segment/outro midpoint frames, every 22 bilingual original-audio cue midpoint, 8 factual subtitle frames, additional full-size 169.5s/355.5s images. These are sampled visual observations, not a claim of watching every frame or human audio listening.
part_preflight: 52/52 encoded native parts independently ffprobed and extracted; all 1080x1440. This preflight was kept separate from final burned review.

layout.native: Current native story column dark blue title/section/stat cards, lime tag/brand, restored logo and native outro. Three chapter cards observed: 世界来到上海 / 大师的主场 / 白玉兰再绽放. No new CSS/card mother template introduced by this review.
layout.canvas: Actual export 1080x1440. Full-frame images and match crops observed, without letterboxing/contain. Existing card background fills canvas.
layout.caption: All 22 original-audio cue midpoint images actually display one English line plus one Chinese line. No four-line stack, clipped glyph, or caption over the face at reviewed samples. Narration sampled uses native Chinese only; cover/outro avoid duplicate captions. Card captions sit tightly above existing native footer, whose position was preserved.

known_tradeoffs: Fixed-center full-canvas crop intentionally omits some lateral players/ball actions; the archive match clips serve a promotional history film and are not a claim of complete point-path visibility.

2005 328–343s source window starts after serve opening; its real score frame is 30–40 and break-back reaction is not the championship celebration. Source/frame review records this; broader narrative describes the earlier 6–5/30–0 crisis, not literal frame-matched replay.
Historical 2005/2012/2014 broadcast detail is lower than modern stadium/official portrait material; no 4K archive-quality claim.
Actual libass output fits long English captions; PIL-only width prediction was explicitly discarded after actual burned pixels were viewed.
audio_scope: No claim of human audio listening or silent English-free windows by visual inspection. Original-audio verification remains with independent dual-ASR/audio review.
limitations: Sampled all scene midpoints and all original-audio caption cue midpoints; not exhaustive every-frame detection or legal licensing validation.
